The '''Wok-Wok''' was a [[Monkey/Legends|monkey]]-like scavenger that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aris/Legends|Aris]]. They were friendly, and often roamed the platforms strung between the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on which the population lived.

==Behind the scenes==
References to Wok-Woks were removed from the reprinted version of [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']] included in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]''.
